rows.en: Fufufu… right? It's totally suspicious. A matching set with your girlfriend?
That means a couple, right? I've heard it in old movies.
What!? Treating me like some old geezer! Honestly, young people these days…
No… it's nothing like that! Nothing like that…

Hey, Goro!

What's with him? Goro… Did somebody say something that upset him?

Surely not… the bit about going steady… It can't be that…
Goro Watari's rose pendant was his only link to his mother, from whom he had been separated 15 years before.
His mother Shinobu's whereabouts remained a complete mystery, and Goro had come to think of the pendant as a keepsake.
Hang in there!
Ugh… P-please help me…
What's wrong? What happened?
My father, my father…

Your father?

And… what happened to your father?
A rose… a rose monster demanded my father's… my father's blueprints…
Blueprints?

…!?

That pendant…?
Huh? What about this pendant?
No… stay away! Stay away, stay away!!
Hey! Calm down…!
Taeko, was it? Here, drink this…
Thank you…

Now, don't you worry…

Goro and the others are on their way. They won't let anyone lay a finger on your father…

More importantly… what did Dr. Araki complete?
Well… he said it was something called a Conscience Circuit.

A Conscience Circuit!?

Dr. Araki made the same Conscience Circuit as Dr. Komyoji's?
I don't know the details… but I think it's probably the same thing.
That's serious! I wonder if Mitsuko knows?
That's Dr. Araki's laboratory over there.
Right, let's hurry… That rose monster that attacked Taeko worries me.
That's it, right? Dr. Araki's lab…
Come on, let's hurry… That rose monster that attacked Taeko worries me.

Yeah…

But why? I feel like the sound of this pendant is calling me…
Barara…
Neo-Human Empire! Are you the one after Dr. Araki?
Barara… Goro Watari, it's too late! We Neo-Humans will be taking Dr. Araki.
I won't let you! I won't let you get to the lab!
Dr. Araki! I'll defeat the Neo-Humans and save you, I promise.
Dr. Araki! I'll defeat the Neo-Humans and save you, I promise.
Dr. Araki! I'll defeat the Neo-Humans and save you, I promise.
Wait! To rescue Dr. Araki safely, we have to defeat the Neo-Humans first!
Wait! To rescue Dr. Araki safely, we have to defeat the Neo-Humans first!
Wait! To rescue Dr. Araki safely, we have to defeat the Neo-Humans first!
Hello, Araki speaking…
Hello, Dr. Araki? It's Yokoegawa.
Oh, it's you… Looks like your flight's been delayed?
That's right. I'm sorry, Doctor… I'll be a little later than planned.

I don't mind…

but if you're too late, we'll keep Mitsuko waiting. She should be here any…

Doctor!?

What's wrong? Doctor! Doctooor!!
Wh-who are you?
Barara… Dr. Araki, you shall die! Petal Bind!!
Uwaaaagh!!
Damn!? The doctor!
Damn!? The doctor!
Damn!? The doctor!

Ba~rabarabara, Banbaaa!

The Neo-Human Empire has taken Dr. Araki! And you'll die right here!
Like hell! You're the one going down! Today is the Neo-Human Empire's last day!
Like hell! You're the one going down! Today is the Neo-Human Empire's last day!
Like hell! You're the one going down! Today is the Neo-Human Empire's last day!

Fufufu… Goro Watari, no, [VAR6]!

I want power… I want to keep my throne as Emperor! And for that, I must defeat you!

Our battle is over! Die here in agony!
Uwaaagh!
Ba~rabarabara, Banbaaa! It seems… the time has come to settle things with you too.
Bring it on! Emperor Banba!!
Bring it on! Emperor Banba!!
Bring it on! Emperor Banba!!
Fufufufu… Do you think you can beat me? Goro Watari, no, [VAR6]?
I'll win, no matter what!
I shall win, no matter what!
I shall win, no matter what!
Hahaha… Porteutoiyanutumaa!!
Guoooooh!!

Nngh… You, at least, I'll defeat, even if it costs me my life! Curse you, [VAR6]!!

Behold the burning life of Emperor Banba!
So this is the end of Emperor Banba…
So this is the end of Emperor Banba…
So this is the end of Emperor Banba…
Doctor! Dr. Araki!
Ugh… ugh…
Damn… those Neo-Humans!
If only we'd come a little sooner…
Goro, Dr. Araki completed an android Conscience Circuit, just like Father's.
A Conscience Circuit?
He contacted Mitsuko and me… saying he wanted to hand over the blueprints.

U03975: line cut off as the attack begins (U03976 is absent from the batch).
U03979: 花びら縛め rendered 'Petal Bind' (attack name, not in glossary).
U03996/U03997: Sanagiman/Inazuman use 私; slightly more formal 'I shall'.
